description: Fetch a Wikipedia editor's public account statistics by username or user-page URL. Returns name, URL, language, user ID, edit count, user groups, implicit groups, rights, registration date, gender, and derived flags for bot/admin/blocked status. Uses the public MediaWiki Action API; no login required.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Wikipedia username (e.g. {username}) or full user-page URL https://{lang}.wikipedia.org/wiki/User:{username}.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language edition code (default zh). Common values: zh/en/ja/ko/fr/de/es/ru; any valid MediaWiki language code works.
